ideas.pitch: A localized energy grid strain forecasting tool using Poisson regression and historical ERCOT data to predict peak load incidents and price volatility in Austin.
ideas.title: Austin Grid Load Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of hard engineering and predictive modeling from the AI forecasting hackathon, highly relevant to local Austin judges.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace for local Austin food trucks and small businesses with automated USDC escrow payments.
ideas.title: ATX Local Merchant Escrow Market
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the autonomous agent and escrow payment architecture that won the Synthesis Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite and aerial land monitoring platform to track environmental compliance for construction sites in Austin.
ideas.title: Austin GreenSite Compliance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the runner-up winner at the Xcelerate Hackathon by combining geospatial data with automated compliance checks.

ideas.pitch: A personalized multi-agent student support platform tailored specifically for university curriculum navigation using LangGraph and RAG.
ideas.title: UT Austin Student Multi-Agent Support
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates the 1st place GreenNovation Hackathon architecture using specialized multi-agent student support frameworks.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient acquisition and trust engine specifically built for local specialty health and wellness clinics in Austin.
ideas.title: Austin Health Trust & Patient Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the proven 1st prize-winning blueprint from the Prize Hackathon for localized health trust and acquisition workflows.
